digest.component_or_area: inbound link differ and apply layer
propositions: The inbound link differ is ADD-only by construction; a link deleted in Jira is never removed from the local ticket, while the outbound direction has a removal path, creating asymmetry.

The apply layer silently discards non-add link records via `action != 'add': continue` at apply_inbound_records.py:560-562, preventing any removal record from reaching rebar.unlink even if the differ emitted one.

A peer-side link deletion is currently safe by default (local-wins-and-restore on next pass) but represents a coverage gap relative to the mutation table's oracle, which asserts deleted links are positively absent locally.

The original design using managed_refs as arbitration cannot distinguish between a brand-new local link never pushed and a link the peer deleted, making both data-loss and safe outcomes indistinguishable to the guards.
The feature has been deferred based on ecosystem research showing most tools do not mirror link deletions due to data-loss risk, and this is not a Cloud/DC parity gap but a shared-core behavior.
